message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && rm -rf /tmp/obj /tmp/src && mkdir -p /tmp/obj /tmp/src && n=0; fail=0; while read f; do
  base=$(echo "$f" | tr '/' '_' | sed 's/\.pi$//')
  src="/tmp/src/${base}.c"
  # strip the problematic _Float typedefs
  sed -e '/^typedef float _Float32;$/d' -e '/^typedef double _Float32x;$/d' -e '/^typedef double _Float64;$/d' -e '/^typedef long double _Float64x;$/d' "$f" > "$src"
  out="/tmp/obj/${base}.o"
  if gcc -g -O0 -w -fno-sanitize=all -c "$src" -o "$out" 2>/tmp/err.txt; then
    n=$((n+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1))
    echo "FAIL: $f"
    head -3 /tmp/err.txt
  fi
done < /tmp/pi_files.txt
echo "compiled: $n, failed: $fail"
echo "---count obj---"; ls /tmp/obj/*.o | wc -l
